build_mlp_classifier: build a multi-layer perceptron classifier with configurable dimensions and batch normalization
create_mlp_with_batchnorm: create an MLP network with batch normalization layers between linear transformations
create_mlp_with_dropout: create an MLP network with dropout regularization for training robustness
create_mlp_without_relu: create an MLP network without ReLU activation for the final output layer
run_mlp_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MLP classifier with a batch of input data
